summary.text: Madison Whittle is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 49th District, which covers part of Halifax County, part of Pittsylvania County and the city of Danville, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Whittle sits on the House committees on Courts of Justice and Education.

paragraphs.text: Madison Whittle was born in Danville, VA, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Whittle's education as George Washington High School, Danville, VA.
The profile gives Whittle's occupation as president and CEO of MJRW, Inc.
Whittle's listed memberships and affiliations include Danville Pittsylvania County Chamber of Commerce; Danville Rotary Club.
